answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a gale bet on surviving 70 epochs of grading, and every walnut settlement recomputes the horizon schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 70 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
